result.description:
Kickstart Your Career as a Admin Trainee with MEGT!   Are you detail-focused, and ready to launch your career in administration? MEGT is offering an exciting full-time Admin Traineeship opportunity with one of our valued clients in Taree, NSW, commencing in May. Step into a supportive environment where you'll gain hands-on experience while working as an Administrative Assistant.   
 About the Role 
 This role is scheduled to commence in May. As an Administrative Assistant, you'll play a key role in supporting daily office operations and ensuring the smooth running of business activities. This is a fantastic opportunity to build practical skills while working towards a nationally recognised qualification.   
 What We're Looking For 
 
 Strong organisational and time management skills 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other office software 
 High attention to detail with the ability to multitask 
 A positive, team-oriented, and customer-focused attitude 
 
 What You'll Receive 
 
 Personalised one-on-one mentoring throughout your traineeship 
 A nationally recognised qualification 
 Comprehensive TAFE training leading to a Certificate III in Business 
 Weekly pay 
 Professional development and long-term career opportunities 
 Flexible work arrangements supporting work-life balance 
 
 About the company 
 Established in 1972, this family-operated business has been proudly supplying top-quality farming and milking equipment to residential, commercial, rural and agricultural customers across the Mid North Coast for over five decades. They offer a wide range of dairy equipment, convenient farm delivery, mobile shopping outlets, preventative maintenance services, and access to leading milking equipment brands to help keep operations running smoothly.   Interested? Click  "Apply Now"  or for more information or visit https:// https://www.megt.com.au/jobs   At MEGT, we enable people to start their careers through Apprenticeships and Traineeships and support large and small businesses to recruit, train and grow careers. Our purpose is to provide life changing, lifelong learning and employment solutions for all. We invite you to be part of our story. By applying, you agree to receive information about other MEGT employment and education opportunities   MEGT is committed to being a Child Safe Organisation and an Equal Opportunity Employer. We have zero tolerance of racism, discrimination, harm, or abuse. We have a culture that values safety, diversity, and inclusion and encourage   all qualified applicants, including minorities, genders, protected veterans, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.
